portInfo.description: Half Moon Cay (Little San Salvador) is the Bahamas private-island product long associated with Holland America Line and now branded RelaxAway, Half Moon Cay. The HAL destination page frames it as a low-crowd beach day with roaming drinks carts, snorkel/kayak rentals, pickleball, Destination Dining BBQ and Lobster Shack, plus cabanas and Deluxe Beach Villas. A 10 Dec 2024 joint release with Carnival Cruise Line announces a multi-year enhancement: distinct south and north welcome plazas over more than one mile of beach, a refreshed south-side Beach Club, a newly developed north side with lunch venues/bars/tram, and a newly constructed north pier intended to allow ships to dock — including Carnival Excel-class ships visiting for the first time — with completion beginning summer 2026 and continuing through year-end. Until that pier is confirmed in service for a given sailing, treat transfer mode (tender vs alongside) as ship-day specific. This is a private / cruise-line destination, not a public ferry harbour.

thingsToDo.practicalTip: Do not assume “always tender” or “always dock” during 2026 expansion — check the day’s port notes.
